articles.title: Meet Meta’s JiTTests: LLM-Generated Tests Designed to Fail Before Risky Code Lands
articles.excerpt: Meta has moved Catching JiTTests into production.  The LLM system writes tests designed to fail on risky diffs, and caught 74 privacy SEVs before landing in H1 2026, with a 60% engineer-reported true-positive rate

articles.title: xAI releases Grok-4.3 with native long-horizon agent scaffolding
articles.excerpt: New model demonstrates 4.2× improvement on multi-step software engineering benchmarks and sustains coherent agent trajectories beyond 110k tokens.

articles.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen4-Max: 2.4T MoE, 71B Active, 1M Context
articles.excerpt: Alibaba released Qwen4-Max, a proprietary 2. 4T-parameter MoE model with 71B active parameters, native vision and a 1M-token context

articles.title: Hark Releases Handoff², a 2x Faster Computer-Use Agent for Hark Pro
articles.excerpt: Hark has released Handoff², the computer-use agent inside Hark Pro.  It averages 2x faster than v1, completes 82% of 478 internal web tasks, and learned to batch actions through latency-penalized RL

articles.title: Figure 03 completes 43-hour autonomous factory shift with zero interventions
articles.excerpt: Humanoid achieves new milestone in unsupervised operation, performing 1,240 unique tasks across three assembly lines at the BMW South Carolina plant.
